title: PIXEL NOVA DIGITALS — Free in-browser creative tools (image, video, voiceover) with Internet Identity

requirements.summary: Create a branded client-facing site with clear navigation to all free tools and a placeholder for future tools.
acceptanceCriteria: A landing/home page exists with PIXEL NOVA DIGITALS branding and a clear list of tools.
All user-facing text is in English.
The UI indicates the site is free (no pricing/paywall UI).
Navigation lets users access each tool from the home page.

file_operations.description: Create the app shell and route wiring (home + tool pages + My History) so every tool is reachable from the home page; include a global layout (header/nav/footer) with clear “100% Free” messaging.
Implement the PIXEL NOVA DIGITALS landing page: branded hero section, tool list/cards for Text-to-Image/Text-to-Video/Text-to-Voiceover, and a visible placeholder card/section for future tools.
Create a reusable header/navigation component (used by App layout) that links to Home and each tool page, plus a My History entry. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a lightweight footer that reiterates the site is free and provides basic site identity/branding.

requirements.summary: Add a client-only Text-to-Image generator with preview and download.
acceptanceCriteria: User can enter a prompt and click Generate to produce an image preview.
User can download the generated image as a file.
Generation works without calling any third-party AI provider APIs.

file_operations.description: Create the Text-to-Image page: prompt input, Generate action, deterministic in-browser image generation (e.g., canvas-based procedural output derived from the prompt), preview, and download-as-PNG control. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Implement a pure client-side image generator utility (no network calls) that renders a prompt-derived composition to a Canvas and returns a downloadable blob/data URL.
Create a shared UI component for showing generated results (preview area + metadata + download button) to reuse across tools. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the Text-to-Image page into routing and navigation so it is accessible from Home and the global header.

requirements.summary: Add a client-only Text-to-Voiceover tool using browser speech synthesis with playback controls.
acceptanceCriteria: User can enter text and trigger voice playback.
User can stop playback and re-run with edited text.
No third-party AI provider APIs are used.

file_operations.description: Create the Text-to-Voiceover page using the browser SpeechSynthesis API: text area, voice selection (where available), play/pause/resume/stop controls, and clear status messaging (e.g., “Playing”, “Stopped”). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a client-side wrapper around SpeechSynthesis to manage utterance lifecycle, pause/resume/stop, and safe re-run with edited text (no external services).
Wire the Text-to-Voiceover page into routing and navigation so it is accessible from Home and the global header.

requirements.summary: Add a client-only Text-to-Video generator producing a simple animated video with preview and download.
acceptanceCriteria: User can enter a prompt and click Generate to produce a playable video preview.
User can download the generated video file.
Generation works without calling any third-party AI provider APIs.

file_operations.description: Create the Text-to-Video page: prompt input, Generate action, in-browser animation rendered to Canvas, recorded via MediaRecorder to a video blob (e.g., webm), with preview player and download control. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Implement a pure client-side video generator utility that renders an animated scene to Canvas and records it via MediaRecorder, returning a blob URL for preview and a downloadable file.
Wire the Text-to-Video page into routing and navigation so it is accessible from Home and the global header.

requirements.summary: Add Internet Identity sign-in and a per-user “My History” UI that persists across sessions via backend calls.
acceptanceCriteria: User can sign in/out with Internet Identity.
After sign-in, generated items are associated to the signed-in principal.
A “My History” section lists prior generations with timestamp and type (image/video/voiceover) and allows re-opening an item.

file_operations.description: Add a Login/Logout button using the existing Internet Identity hook; on logout clear cached query data to avoid leaking personalized history across sessions. Use the selected authorization component’s frontend guidance for login/logout state handling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement a first-login profile setup dialog asking for a display name; use backend getCallerUserProfile/saveCallerUserProfile to avoid showing principal IDs. Use the selected authorization component’s user profile setup guidance; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a react-query hook to fetch the current user profile from the backend actor with correct loading states to prevent modal flash, following the selected authorization component guidance; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a react-query hook to fetch the signed-in user’s generation history from the backend actor and expose loading/error states for the My History page.
Create a small helper/hook to persist a generation record (type/prompt/metadata) to the backend after a client-side generation completes, gated so it only runs when authenticated.

Create a “My History” page that requires sign-in, lists prior generations with timestamp and type, and supports re-opening items by showing stored prompt + metadata (and links back to the relevant tool page). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a reusable auth gate component used by My History (and optionally tool persistence sections) to show a friendly sign-in prompt when the user is not authenticated. Use the selected authorization component’s guidance about keeping application data behind login; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

After successful client-side image generation, call the backend to store a generation record (type=image, prompt, metadata containing download-friendly info like mime/size and an internal reference such as a localStorage key). Ensure this only runs when signed in.

After successful client-side video generation, call the backend to store a generation record (type=video, prompt, metadata such as duration/format and an internal reference such as a localStorage key). Ensure this only runs when signed in.

When voiceover playback is triggered (or on explicit “Save to History”), call the backend to store a generation record (type=sound, text prompt, metadata describing voice name/rate/pitch). Ensure this only runs when signed in.
Implement a small client-side asset reference store (e.g., localStorage/IndexedDB abstraction) so generated blobs can be re-opened locally when possible using identifiers saved in history metadata.
Wire My History route and integrate LoginButton + ProfileSetupDialog into the global layout so sign-in and profile setup are available across the app.

requirements.summary: Implement a cohesive, distinct, responsive visual theme across all pages (avoid default look; avoid blue/purple primary).
acceptanceCriteria: Theme is consistent across pages (buttons, inputs, cards, headings).
Theme does not rely on blue/purple as the primary palette unless explicitly necessary.
UI is responsive and usable on mobile and desktop.

file_operations.description: Update global CSS variables (Tailwind/shadcn tokens) to a distinctive non-blue/purple primary palette (e.g., warm charcoal + ember/orange accent), and set consistent base typography/spacing defaults used across the site.
Extend Tailwind theme as needed for the PIXEL NOVA DIGITALS look (brand-specific colors/gradients/shadows) while keeping responsiveness and consistent components styling.
Create a src-level CSS entry that matches the immutable import in frontend/src/main.tsx by re-exporting/forwarding to frontend/index.css (e.g., via a CSS @import), ensuring global theme styles apply.

Create a consistent tool card component (icon, title, description, CTA) to reuse on Home and optionally inside tool pages for cross-navigation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add and use generated static brand assets (logo, hero illustration, tool icons) from the static assets folder.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced directly by the frontend.
Home page displays the logo and hero illustration.
Each tool entry has a simple icon.

file_operations.description: Add the generated PIXEL NOVA DIGITALS logo file as a static asset at the exact required path and filename.
Add the generated hero illustration file as a static asset at the exact required path and filename.
Add the generated tool icon set file as a static asset at the exact required path and filename.

Reference and render the static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated/pnd-logo.dim_512x512.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/pnd-hero.dim_1600x900.png; use frontend/public/assets/generated/pnd-tool-icons.dim_256x256.png to visually represent each tool entry (image/video/voice).
Use the static logo at frontend/public/assets/generated/pnd-logo.dim_512x512.png in the header for consistent branding across all pages.
